faq.q: What is the origin of Rashedul?
faq.a: Rashedul is associated with Arabic. Rashedul is the Bengali form of Arabic رَاشِدُ الدِّين (Rāshid al-Dīn), meaning 'rightly guided in the faith'.
Yes — the underlying form رَاشِدُ الدِّين is Arabic.
Rashedul can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Rashedul should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Rāshid al-Dīn is a compound of Arabic elements, not itself a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Rashedul mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Rashedul is rendered راشدالدین and carries the sense راشدالدین، هدایت‌یافته دین.
A romanized syllable approximation is ras-he-dul. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Rashedul, rashedul. Script forms are راشد الدين, راشد الدین, راشدالدین, رَاشِدُ الدِّين, राशेदुल.
